title: Cross-regional model substitution risk monitor and OEM pricing tracker
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Establish a lightweight, repeatable monitoring and triage system that detects cross-regional model substitution risk (when vendors change EULAs, pricing, or deprecate models) and continuously tracks OEM pricing shifts for models we surface to customers. Deliverables: signal taxonomy, ETL pipeline for public vendor pricing + telemetry, per-region risk scorecard, alerting rules for PM/RE/Support, and a short playbook with mitigation templates (fallback model mapping, customer comms, pricing adjustment recommendations). This ticket scopes discovery, prototype scoring logic, and delivery of a dashboard wireframe plus a runbook for on-call and AE handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype pipeline ingests pricing snapshots from 3 public sources (vendor pricing pages, model catalogs, and cloud marketplace listings)
Region-aware substitution score computed nightly with documented factors (pricing delta, deprecation notice, model incompatibility, SLA changes)
Alerting configured for score > 0.65 to PMs and Solutions team with automated ticket template
Dashboard wireframe validated in review with Solutions and GTM (2 stakeholders signed off)
Runbook with mitigation playbook and customer communication templates published to Confluence
